exitGate: Daily and weekly reports reconcile to source transactions, expose every calculation, and produce only bounded human-approved recommendations.

forecastVariance.formula: actual service usage cooked lb - approved forecast cooked lb

productionVariance.formula: actual cooked production lb - planned cooked production lb

actualYield.formula: actual cooked production lb / actual raw input lb

wasteRate.formula: waste cooked lb / total cooked inventory available during period
wasteRate.denominator: opening cooked lb + production receipts cooked lb + transfer-in cooked lb

endingInventoryRate.formula: closing on-hand cooked lb / total cooked inventory available during period

planAdherence.formula: loads started and completed within approved tolerances / completed non-cancelled loads

reconciliation.inventoryEquation: opening + production receipts + transfer in - service usage - waste - transfer out + adjustments = closing on hand

learning.basis: weighted actual service usage divided by approved forecast

scopeBoundary: No claim of durable report or recommendation persistence.
Notification delivery and administration remain Build 11.8.0.
